blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) is ready to assist police in the manhunt for Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa if requested, its spokesperson said on Tuesday. AFP spokesperson Col. Francel Margareth Padilla said the Philippine National Police (PNP) will lead any law enforcement operation involving dela Rosa. “This is a law enforcement operation. So, the Philippine National Police is the frontline in this issue,” Padilla said during a press briefing. “Nonetheless, your Armed Forces of the Philippines – if there is a request to our end, then we will respond to it,” she noted.
